hypothesis: W-R23's perfect score may rely on same-time-index positive alignment. Test frozen W-R22 mask-aware learner without retraining when the candidate is generated from monotone (order-preserving) local duplicate/skip warps, and compare against local reordering negatives.
freeze: All warp index maps, generators, masks, swaps, fresh seed cohorts and thresholds preregistered before first-use. No positive/negative mutation or post-result fitting.
learning: Frozen W-R22 original naive_augmented and maskaware_augmented trained models only on original development seeds240..255, exactly 16 features and 16 weights+bias, 1728 examples/model, 32 epochs. No new training on warps, generators or sealed cohort.
input: Same 16 tick, four-channel synthetic input as original, candidate offset79 and deterministic per-tick jitter amplitude3, all-zero row erasure at frozen positions 2,5,8,10,3 from first 3/5. Legitimate mono retiming applied before candidate observation.
arms: naive_augmented: exact W-R22 learned weights and naive four-channel top-two transition feature
maskaware_augmented: exact W-R22 learned weights and all-zero-row-aware transition feature
success: ORDER_PRESERVING_WARP_TRANSFER iff maskaware model accuracy>=0.80 in every one of 12 nonidentity generator×mask×warp cells and naive aggregate on nonidentity<=0.60. PARTIAL iff maskaware aggregate on nonidentity>.60 and exceeds naive aggregate by>=.05 without strict success. NEGATIVE otherwise.
controls: Warp maps monotonic, endpoints same, no changes at tail swapped tick positions11-14
For each positive/negative candidate pair identical anchor and multiset, only negative swaps two valid unmasked rows
Holdout seeds not exposed in prior research
Same trained model width/epochs, no additional sensors, budget or model calls
Record all outcomes, first-use archive, single full Go regression and exact Git source/provenance
claim_limit: Order-preserving monotone resampling of deterministic toy sequences, no broad cognitive inference.
